import sqlite3
from collections import Counter
con = sqlite3.connect('file:data/guidebook.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
def show(q, title):
    cur=con.execute(q); cols=[d[0] for d in cur.description]; rows=cur.fetchall()
    print(f"=== {title}  ({len(rows)} rows shown)"); print(" | ".join(cols))
    for r in rows: print(" | ".join("" if v is None else str(v)[:90] for v in r))
show("select * from base_icf order by icf_code limit 15","base_icf sample")
show("select * from access_need_icf order by need_code, icf_code limit 15","access_need_icf sample")
show("select * from identity_icf_map order by link_id limit 15","identity_icf_map sample")
show("select * from identity_need_icf order by triple_id limit 15","identity_need_icf sample")
show("select link_id, extraction_id, identity_code, icf_code, needs_code, basis from extraction_lens_links where icf_code is not null","extraction_lens_links icf_code (all non-null)")
show("select gap_id, category, status, identity_code, icf_code, needs_code from gaps where icf_code is not null","gaps icf_code (all non-null)")
show("select specification_id, parameter_id, identity_code, icf_code, needs_code, state from specifications limit 15","specifications (8 rows, all)")
show("select need_code, family, typical_stakes from access_needs limit 15","access_needs (need names are the need_code column)")
show("select identity_code, display_name, category from base_taxonomy_identity limit 15","base_taxonomy_identity names")
print("=== prefix distribution: base_icf.component")
print(con.execute("select component, count(*) from base_icf group by component order by component").fetchall())
print("=== prefix from code (substr 1)")
print(con.execute("select substr(icf_code,1,1) p, count(*) from base_icf group by p order by p").fetchall())
print("=== prefix distribution over referencing tables")
for t in ['access_need_icf','identity_icf_map','identity_need_icf']:
    print(t, con.execute(f"select substr(icf_code,1,1) p, count(*) from {t} group by p order by p").fetchall())
print("=== digit-count level (no level column exists in base_icf; ICF convention: 1 digit chapter, 2 block, 3 category, 4+ finer)")
lv=Counter()
for (code,) in con.execute("select icf_code from base_icf"):
    digits=sum(ch.isdigit() for ch in code[1:]); lv[digits]+=1
print(sorted(lv.items()))
print(con.execute("select length(icf_code), count(*) from base_icf group by 1 order by 1").fetchall())
print("is_range", con.execute("select is_range, count(*) from base_icf group by 1").fetchall())
print("base_icf codes NOT referenced by any link table:", con.execute("""select count(*) from base_icf b where not exists(select 1 from access_need_icf a where a.icf_code=b.icf_code) and not exists(select 1 from identity_icf_map m where m.icf_code=b.icf_code) and not exists(select 1 from identity_need_icf n where n.icf_code=b.icf_code)""").fetchone())

import sqlite3, sys
c = sqlite3.connect('file:data/guidebook.db?mode=ro', uri=True)
q = lambda s, *a: c.execute(s, a).fetchall()
esc = lambda x: '' if x is None else str(x).replace('|', '\\|').replace('\n', ' ')
o = []
v = q('pragma user_version')[0][0]
o.append(f"# Base gathered: ICF codes, access needs, identities\n\nGenerated from `data/guidebook.db` (schema {v}) by `gather_base.py`; re-run rather than trust. Read-only.\n")

# ICF
rows = q("select icf_code, component, is_range, title, title_source from base_icf order by component, icf_code")
used = {r[0]: [] for r in rows}
for t, col in (('access_need_icf', 'access need'), ('identity_icf_map', 'identity'), ('identity_need_icf', 'identity-need triple'),
               ('extraction_lens_links', 'extraction'), ('gaps', 'gap')):
    for (k, n) in q(f"select icf_code, count(*) from {t} where icf_code is not null group by 1"):
        if k in used: used[k].append(f"{n} {col}")
o.append(f"## 1. ICF codes in `base_icf` ({len(rows)})\n")
names = {'b': 'b: body functions', 'd': 'd: activities and participation', 'e': 'e: environmental factors', 's': 's: body structures'}
for comp in 'bdes':
    r = [x for x in rows if x[1] == comp]
    o.append(f"### {names[comp]} ({len(r)})\n")
    if not r: o.append("None.\n"); continue
    o.append("| code | range | title (as stored) | title source | referenced by |\n|---|---|---|---|---|")
    for code, _, rng, title, src in r:
        o.append(f"| {code} | {'yes' if rng else ''} | {esc(title) or '(none stored)'} | {esc(src)} | {esc('; '.join(used[code]))} |")
    o.append("")

# needs
needs = q("select need_code, family, design_obligation, absorbs, notes from access_needs order by family, need_code")
o.append(f"## 2. Access needs in `access_needs` ({len(needs)})\n")
o.append("| need | family | design obligation | absorbs | ICF codes (`access_need_icf`, confidence) | notes |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for code, fam, ob, ab, nt in needs:
    icf = ', '.join(f"{i} ({cf})" for i, cf in q("select icf_code, confidence from access_need_icf where need_code=? order by icf_code", code))
    o.append(f"| {code} | {esc(fam)} | {esc(ob)} | {esc(ab)} | {icf} | {esc(nt)} |")
o.append("")

# identities
ids = q("select identity_code, display_name, category, description, parent_code, is_compound, status, superseded_by_identity, superseded_by_need from base_taxonomy_identity order by category, identity_code")
o.append(f"## 3. Disability identities in `base_taxonomy_identity` ({len(ids)})\n")
o.append("| code | display name | category | description | parent | compound | status | superseded by | ICF codes (`identity_icf_map`, live rows) |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for code, dn, cat, d, par, comp, st, sbi, sbn in ids:
    icf = ', '.join(i for (i,) in q("select distinct icf_code from identity_icf_map where identity_code=? and retired_at is null order by icf_code", code))
    sb = sbi or sbn or ''
    o.append(f"| {code} | {esc(dn)} | {esc(cat)} | {esc(d)} | {esc(par)} | {'yes' if comp else ''} | {esc(st)} | {esc(sb)} | {icf} |")
o.append("")
open(sys.argv[1], 'w').write('\n'.join(o))
print(len(rows), len(needs), len(ids))
PY
